notes.subject: דישן
notes.rationale: Deer and antelope names in this list are rare or unique in the Tanakh; Bambara has no exact words, so compound pictures (kulu-bagan mountain-animal, bɔbaga the-leaper, sen-fininin, sen-yaw) carry the literal shape.

notes.subject: senba / sen
notes.rationale: Bamanankan 'sen' covers antelope and gazelle generally; the seven distinct Hebrew species are distinguished by compounds, not separate names.

translation: senba ni sen ni sen-kokoron ni kulu-bagan ni bɔbaga ni sen-fininin ni sen-yaw — ayil, tsevi, yachmur, ako, dishon, teyo, zemer.
